    Realizing the path category by chosen arrows (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    Given morphisms g a : F y ⟶ F x of a k-linear category for the arrows a : y ⟶ x of a quiver, paths are realized by composition (pathR) and the k-linear path category kQ by linear extension (realizeR); the realization is a functor (realizeR_comp). This is the realization kQ → ℳ by lifted arrows of deformation-refinements.tex.
